payload.text: Home - Aura Biosciences Skip to content A focused vision: targeted treatment to transform ocular cancer care. Aura Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company leveraging a novel targeted oncology technology to develop a potentially transformative first-in-class therapy for patients with ocular cancers. Virus-Like Drug Conjugates (VDCs) Our proprietary technology enables the targeting of ocular cancers using Virus-Like Particles, or VLPs, that selectively target tumor cells and deliver conjugated cytotoxic molecules to create Virus-Like Drug Conjugates, or VDCs. Choroidal melanoma is a rare, vision- and life-threatening ocular cancer There are no approved drug therapies for the first line treatment of primary choroidal melanoma, and the long-term prognosis is poor with death occurring in more than 50% of cases. Current standard of care treatment with radiotherapy leaves many patients with profound vision loss, potential disfiguration, and a wide range of comorbidities. New options for early treatment intervention that arrest tumor growth and preserve vision are urgently needed. Careers [/about] Overview - Aura Biosciences Overview - Aura Biosciences Skip to content Company Overview Our Mission At Aura, our mission is to transform the treatment of ocular cancers with a rigorous approach to our science, a deep understanding of these diseases, and an unwavering focus on patients. Our focus Our therapeutic candidate, belzupacap sarotalocan (bel-sar), is being developed as a first-line, potentially curative and vision-preserving treatment for early choroidal melanoma, a rare form of ocular cancer for which there are currently no FDA-approved therapies in the primary setting. Building on this foundation, we are advancing early clinical studies of bel-sar in other forms of ocular cancer, including metastases to the choroid and cancers of the ocular surface, with the goal of enabling broad access to bel-sar for patients living with eye cancers.
